title: 2 World Trade Center construction · October 2026

buildingCutout.basis: The contemporaneous map assigns a 373.7 m future building to this outline. For the October 6 construction view, suppress the mapped footprint when the construction mesh has loaded.

note: The aerial dated October 6, 2026 shows the low core, two major open chambers, orange deck rails and a tall lattice crane. PMTiles street frontages and the planned envelope register the construction block. Construction equipment, exact heights and formwork are photo-based estimates. This baseline is used until the October 31 reference.

terrainReference.basis: Sampled viewer terrain at the placement anchor. Hoarding grades follow checked site samples and foundations extend into the terrain.
